channel.description: macOS updates for Trails RG Studio (Sparkle)

item.title: Version 1.50.14 (146)
item.description:
RAW to TIFF conversion fix

  • Correctly validates large Nikon TIFF files whose metadata directory is stored near the end of the file.
  • Accepts valid RGB TIFF output with associated alpha.
  • Shows the actual native reason when a batch item fails.
  • Includes corrected external-drive free-space detection.
